member.summary: Registers database services as singletons: , an AOT-friendly built via , , , and . The DI container owns the lifetime and disposes its connection pool on shutdown.
member.remarks:
is registered explicitly via instead of AddNpgsqlDataSource for four architectural reasons:
Minimal dependencies: on Npgsql 10.x, AddNpgsqlDataSource requires the separate Npgsql.DependencyInjection NuGet package.
Native AOT & trimming: AddNpgsqlDataSource instantiates the full , pulling default codecs (geometry, network, full-text search, etc.), whereas uses the pay-per-play .
RLS & resilience boundary: AddNpgsqlDataSource also registers and DbConnection directly in DI, which could encourage bypassing and its transactional Row-Level Security (SET LOCAL) + Polly v8 execution pipeline.
Same DI lifetime & test reuse: registering the factory as a singleton gives the DI container full ownership of disposal on shutdown while allowing tests to call directly without building a service provider.
member.param: Settings that parameterize the default resilience pipelines.
Database connection and behavior settings.
member.returns: The same instance to allow call chaining.

member.name: T:MelloSilveiraTools.Database.RelationalDatabase.Repositories.PostgresRepository
member.summary: Pure-Npgsql, Native AOT-compatible repository for PostgreSQL. Registered as Singleton in DI; borrows pooled connections from the DI-managed singleton and executes every operation inside a single-round-trip scoped by transaction-local Row-Level Security context. Safe for concurrent use.

remarks.para: Every operation is executed via with SELECT set_config('app.current_user_id', @UserId, true) prepended as the first batch command. Under PostgreSQL's extended query protocol, all commands in an run atomically inside a single implicit transaction block until the trailing Sync message — eliminating explicit BEGIN/COMMIT network round-trips while guaranteeing that PostgreSQL resets app.current_user_id automatically before returning the connection to the pool.

All non-streaming database operations are wrapped by , which transparently retries transient failures (connection drops, deadlocks, serialization failures, timeouts). collections are constructed once per repository call (avoiding repeated reflection); the first attempt binds the original instances directly (zero extra allocations), and retries bind detached copies to prevent parameter-collection ownership conflicts.
Per-command timeouts are taken from : applies to single-row operations (insert, update, delete-by-id, get-by-id, exists) and applies to batch operations (bulk insert, bulk upsert).

member.param: Provider responsible for generating and caching PostgreSQL statements.
Mandatory provider resolving the active user identifier for PostgreSQL RLS batch scoping.

member.name: T:MelloSilveiraTools.Database.RelationalDatabase.Sql.Provider.ISqlProvider
member.summary: Provides SQL statements tailored to a specific database dialect for an entity type provided per call.

remarks.para: The SQL strings returned by this interface contain textual placeholders prefixed with # that the caller (typically ) substitutes via before execution. Implementations must keep these placeholder names stable. The placeholders currently emitted are:

item.description: #WHERE — replaced with the full WHERE ... clause built from a FilterBase, or with null/empty when no filter applies.
#ORDERBY — replaced with the ORDER BY ... clause derived from the requested SortOrder.
#LIMIT — replaced with LIMIT n for paginated queries (removed otherwise).
#OFFSET — replaced with OFFSET n for paginated queries (removed otherwise).
#JOIN — replaced with LEFT/INNER JOIN clauses derived from [ForeignKeyColumn] attributes on the entity (only present in SELECT templates).

remarks.para: Internal placeholders such as #TABLE_NAME, #TABLE_ALIAS, #COLUMNS, #VALUES, #PARAMETER_NAMES, #PRIMARY_KEY, #VALUES_TO_UPDATE, #UNIQUE_COLUMNS and #UNIQUE_UPDATES are resolved by the provider itself before the SQL is returned, and callers should not see them in the produced strings.

member.name: T:MelloSilveiraTools.Database.RelationalDatabase.Sql.Provider.PostgresSqlProvider
member.summary: Registered as Singleton in DI. Thread-safe and Native AOT-compatible. Backed by per-type static generic caches.

remarks.para: Generated SQL strings are memoized per entity type in static generic caches (and a keyed by batch size for bulk inserts). Entries live for the lifetime of the application so reflection-based SQL generation runs at most once per entity type and operation without delegate reflection or AOT hazards.

For entities inheriting from that declare one or more properties, user_id is automatically appended to the ON CONFLICT unique key list so conflict resolution aligns with PostgreSQL multi-tenant unique constraints (UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (..., user_id)).
